user_approval.statement_summary: User explicitly directed immediate forward progress to Cart 2.0, prioritized efficiency and safe continuous progress, and approved a coordinator-chat / worker-Work-or-Codex execution model with Luna Light/Medium only unless absolutely necessary.

committed: Owner Mission Control + authoritative Skins scoring/control
conditional: AUTO Vibe only after stable hysteresis/non-flapping replay and runtime-cost acceptance

interfaces_frozen.scoring: Existing league_state.state_json.skins.weeks[date] authority; paired-owner mutation guards; authoritative reread.
interfaces_frozen.owner_control: One desired/confirmed semantic model. Local cart-LAN direct when reachable; authenticated remote relay when not; stale cache never supplies mutation authority.
interfaces_frozen.hardware_boundary: AUX may be physically disconnected by the parallel hardware lane. Offline/host software work continues; live AUX absence is not a software regression.

slider_touchability.requirement: All high-frequency course sliders must have a finger-friendly interaction region; target at least 44x44 CSS/pt-equivalent for the thumb/track interaction area and avoid requiring precise acquisition of a tiny native thumb.
slider_touchability.acceptance: Owner can acquire and adjust each slider reliably one-handed on iPhone/iPad without repeated attempts.

brightness_semantics.observed_problem: Below roughly 20 Matrix appears effectively off; roughly 20-60 visibly loses participating LEDs/scene structure, forcing uncomfortable brightness for full-looking animations.
brightness_semantics.invariant: For every nonzero brightness setting, animation geometry, pixel participation, audio-driven behavior, motion, and scene evolution remain materially identical to the full-brightness frame aside from unavoidable channel quantization.
brightness_semantics.implementation_direction: Generate the complete canonical frame first; apply brightness only as a final output/perceptual luminance transform. Do not use brightness to gate pixels, animation state, audio features, kernel behavior, or scene complexity.
brightness_semantics.ui_requirement: Low-night range must provide useful perceptual granularity while preserving true maximum.

no_repeat: No Foundation re-qualification unless an explicit invalidator changes renderer/runtime assumptions.
No serial live flashes for lane-local work.
No broad product ideation before core acceptance.
No worker should reread full project history when current authority and lane checkpoint resolve the task.

worker_compute_policy.default_reasoning: LIGHT for bounded routine edits/tests; MEDIUM for integration/debugging
worker_compute_policy.escalation_trigger: Only after two materially different bounded attempts fail on the same evidence-backed blocker, or when the coordinator identifies a genuinely novel cross-subsystem correctness problem that Luna Medium cannot resolve.
worker_compute_policy.coordinator_surface: Regular Chat remains authority/architecture/review surface; Work executes multi-step tasks; Codex only for genuinely repository-native edits/build/test/debug work.
